Breakfast · Medium

Stuffed French Bread

A crusty and crunchy delight that is filled with cheese and mushrooms. There is so much to love!

5 minPreparation
20 minCooking
2Servings

Ingredients

For 2 servings

Let’s make it.

  1. Cut the loaf of bread horizontally. Scoop out the soft bread out of each half and set aside.
  2. In a large pan, cook the garlic, mushrooms, onion and green capsicum over medium heat for 2 minutes.
  3. Beat the cream cheese with the oregano. Stir in the mushroom mixture.
  4. Spread Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup in the scooped out loaf; fill with mushroom mixture. Cover with the top half of the loaf, press down lightly and wrap in foil.
  5. Place on a baking sheet and bake in a preheated hot oven for 5-10 minutes, or roast on a tawa. Leave to cool for 5 minutes.
  6. Slice crusty, crunchy Kissan Stuffed French Bread into thick slices to reveal its cheesy mushroom filling.
